items.html: And it is for the reason that the two upper joints of the NH of Arich ascend there, to the place of the Chazeh of AVI, at the place of her breasts, to make there a phase of breasts for the woman, in order to nurse her son afterwards. And when the NH are divided into the phase of a number of joints, and not of complete measures, as was said in the first phase, it follows that what remains of Arich for ZON is the four joints of the NH, a third of the Tifferet, and the whole Yesod. And it is known that the Yesod is nothing but the measure of a single third of the Tifferet.
